preamble.summary: 2 Samuel 11 narrates David's adultery with Bathsheba and the murder of Uriah. The chapter is one of the most theologically and morally weighty in the OT. 4QSamᵃ preserves portions with no significant variants — the narrative is preserved across all witnesses without softening.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant variants. The DSS preserves David's sin in full, just as the MT does.
